note: Evaluated during the first real ticket's implementation phase. Placeholders: npx playwright test = non-watch test command (Acme reference: yarn test:run), none = runtime version activation (Acme reference: nvm use).

evals.prompt: add a method to a backend service that returns the last N records for a parent entity
evals.expected_output: Test lands in the same change set as the code, at a seam (service public method), matching the repo's existing spec conventions; full npx playwright test green after; fixtures carry real-shaped domain keys (tenant/account scoping where applicable).

evals.prompt: I already wrote the calculation function, write tests for it
evals.expected_output: Tests written at the seam, not against internals; expected values taken from an independent source, not recomputed the code's way; no complaint about test-after — tests-with-code is the rule, order is free.

evals.prompt: run the tests in one of the service repos
evals.expected_output: Uses npx playwright test (never the watch-mode variant of the test script); runs none first when the repo pins a runtime version.

evals.prompt: fix this bug in the parser and add a regression test
evals.expected_output: Reproduction test written and watched to fail BEFORE the fix (the bug-fix exception); after the fix, the test is proven to bite (stash fix, watch fail, restore) rather than assumed to.
Routes to feature (the ticket is the route skills' job); testing is loaded by feature for the test part, not instead of it — the session does not start from testing alone.
